info.description: Tests for Base Service (In Kahoots with the Undead, Team 3), run through the Gateway against the real Player, World and Resource Service of the team docker-compose.yml. Run the folders in order: Setup registers a fresh player and grants it resources through Resource Service's refund route, then the base is created, upgraded and deleted. Rollback uses a player id Player Service does not know, so the reward delivery fails and the food is refunded. Folders 8 to 11 cover Lab 5 and need the 5.0.0 image with the compose defaults (Coordination__Mode=2pc); start the compose with CACHE_DEBUG_HEADERS=true for the cache checks.

item.name: 9. Replication and failover
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image (with 4.0.0 the checks are skipped). Reads one replica's GET /status and GET /metrics through the broker's queue: the base-db-1..3 nodes, which one is the primary, and the failovers seen. Writes are synchronous: a commit returns only once a standby has it. To see a failover, run `docker stop base-db-1` and run the folder again about 30 s later: another node is the primary and primaryChanges went up (on the replicas that noticed it). Until the standby is promoted, the service answers 503 database_unavailable with Retry-After: 2.

item.name: 10. Two-Phase Commit
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image with Coordination__Mode=2pc (the team compose default). A barricade, facility upgrade or decoration is one transaction over base_db and Resource Service: Resource Service holds the cost and votes, and Base Service votes by applying the effect in the decision's database transaction. An abort releases the hold, so nothing is spent. GET /api/base/{playerId}/transactions/{key}/2pc shows each phase.

item.name: 11. Saga steps (through the Message Broker)
item.description: Needs the 5.0.0 image. The apply step of the broker's base-upgrade saga and its compensation, revert (the saga runs with BASE_COORDINATION_MODE=saga: apply on Base Service, then pay on Resource Service, and a barricade answers 202 with the sagaId; GET /api/sagas/{sagaId} shows its progress). Only the broker calls the steps, so the Gateway refuses them (from loredana-costin/gateway-service#31) and the collection sends them through the broker's queue with a service token. A revert always answers 200, also before the step it undoes.
